name: YeetThePacket
tagline: Turns packet captures into plain-English, evidence-backed security narratives.
problem: Analysts spend hours in packet captures and then struggle to explain findings to non-technical people.
solution: Uploads large captures in chunks, ingests them with packet tools, detects events and generates narratives with evidence and metadata for each detection.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a capture and read the story of each detected event.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “CSE: Network Traffic Exploration” among 261 submissions.
Narratives cite the evidence behind each detection.
A solo builder shipped an end-to-end pipeline.

lessons: Translate expert data for a non-expert reader and show your evidence.
